overall_summary: With fewer than three measured strategy outcomes available and several recent videos recording zero views due to initial rollout timing, confidence is currently low. Performance data indicates that broad, highly recognizable topics (animals, geography, basic science) with engaging hooks perform best in terms of view counts and viewer retention.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'This animal question looks easy... Which animal is the fastest land animal?' achieved the highest view count (713 views) and solid engagement (38 likes).
winning_patterns.action: Reinforce quick-fire animal and geography trivia questions with straightforward A/B/C/D choices.

improvements.pattern: Overly broad or generic phrasing in recent uploads
improvements.evidence: Recent fallback titles have yielded 0 views during initial publishing windows, indicating a need for sharper, more curiosity-inducing hooks.
improvements.action: Pair fundamental trivia questions with stronger curiosity gaps in the title and visual clues right at the start.

retention_insights.evidence: The video 'One tiny clue gives it away! Which gas do plants mainly absorb...' maintained an average view percentage over 120% (42 seconds average view duration).
retention_insights.action: Structure future science questions around a single revealing clue that encourages re-watching or extended dwell time.

best_posting_windows.reason: Observed successful morning publishing timestamps cluster around 07:38 to 08:39 UTC.
Observed high-performing uploads cluster consistently around 12:55 to 13:08 UTC.

next_best_quiz_directions.hook: Most people get this weird wildlife fact totally wrong!
next_best_quiz_directions.visual_type: Side-by-side comparison with an instant visual clue
next_best_quiz_directions.reason: Animal trivia consistently drives the highest view counts and likes across the channel.

avoid_or_limit.item: Dry, textbook science definitions without visual context
avoid_or_limit.reason: Plain definitions lower initial engagement and retention compared to paradoxical or puzzle-style questions.
